methodology.cash: Closing gross plus signed close_swap, close_commission and close_pnl_conversion_fee, scaled by close_money_digits. S3 entry commissions are zero. Human closing cash uses deal grain, including reversal-related closes on a shared position ID.
methodology.R: Original fill-to-initial-SL distance and entry cash-risk basis; fixed after BE.
methodology.excursions: Stored executable liquidation-side quotes; ask for all audited short S3 trades. In-position MFE/MAE anchored to entry, ending at earlier of exit/cutoff. Post-close movement anchored to exit fill, expressed in native price, broker pips and original R.
methodology.post_close: (exit, min(exit+4h,capture)] excluding quotes at/after capture. All ten clocks elapsed four hours. Observed quote gaps are disclosed; continuous capture and hypothetical fills are not guaranteed.
methodology.checkpoint: Last recorded quote at/before target, maximum age six seconds; missing/stale/not-elapsed marks are null.
methodology.touch: Original absolute SL/TP versus executable-side quotes; not a full counterfactual replay of BE, margin, pair occupancy or fills.
methodology.pips: Account-specific pip_position: SpotCrude .01, BTCUSD .1, ETHUSD .1, XAUUSD .1, XAGUSD .01.
methodology.current_float: Account broker float includes all strategies and external inventory. Open S3 net float not independently verified; price-only estimates are labelled separately.
methodology.latest20: Last official supervisor record before cutoff; may span old registrations. Cross-account copies and overlapping rolling windows are not independent samples.
